children: Wipro Limited Sponsored ADR (NSE:WIPRO) reported mixed Q2 results—revenue around $2.61B and 16.5% EBIT margin, but bookings fell ~23% and large deals plunged; company cut 6,700 jobs, faces analyst divergence and regulatory probe while pursuing AI, consulting and partnership-led growth.
Previous Week Recap
WIPRO Q2 Revenue Growth, Profit Dip
: WIPRO Q2: Revenue ₹24,752.7cr (~$2.61bn), +9% YoY; net profit ₹3,200.6cr (slight decline). IT Services revenue $2,611.5m; margin 16.5% (+50bps QoQ). TCV $2.6bn. Q3 IT Services guide $2,571–2,625m.
Wipro ADR Bookings Decline; AI Disruption
: Wipro ADR (WIPRO) reported Q2’27 total bookings $2,595M, down 22.9% sequentially (cc). Large deals (≥$30M) $674M, down 58.6% seq. Company cited AI disruption and senior exits.
Wipro Cut 6,700 Jobs
: Wipro Limited Sponsored ADR (WIPRO) cut 6,700 jobs in the September quarter, the only major Indian tech firm among six to record net layoffs while peers added 17,100 hires.
Wipro ADR Margin 16.5%
: Wipro ADR (WIPRO) posted a 16.5% EBIT margin this quarter, up from 16.0% last quarter and in line with market consensus, showing operating profitability for the period.
Motilal Oswal: WIPRO Neutral
: Motilal Oswal kept Wipro (WIPRO) Neutral with INR 170 target after 2QFY27: revenue USD 2.6B flat QoQ CC, order intake USD 2.6B down 22.9% QoQ CC, adj. EBIT margin 16.5%.
SEBI Fines Supriya Kothari
: SEBI fined Supriya Kothari ₹10 lakh for non-cooperation in a Wipro Limited Sponsored ADR (WIPRO) insider trading probe. Penalty due in 45 days; investigation continues using available records.
Analysts Split on Wipro ADR
: Analysts split on Wipro ADR (WIPRO) after quarterly beat: Citi keeps sell with ₹145 target; several firms lift targets near ₹200. Wipro has many sell ratings among large-cap IT peers.
Wipro Americas Healthcare Weakness
: Wipro ADR (WIPRO) shows weakness in its Americas healthcare segment due to U.S. policy changes affecting that portion of its operations.
Wipro Investments, AI Services Expansion
: Wipro (WIPRO) cited strategic investments and partnerships—Harman DTS engineering expansion and Mindsprint integration from Olam deal—aimed to boost its consulting-led, AI-driven services.
US PERM Pause Not Material
: Wipro (WIPRO) says US Labor's pause on some PERM filings won’t materially affect operations, noting over 80% of its US staff are locally hired and the company will keep investing in local talent.
